title: Boston police warn of spike in downtown cellphone robberies after 2 arrests
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Local News Police say one victim's stolen phone was later used to commit financial fraud.
Boston police are warning the public to be on alert following a recent string of cellphone robberies in the downtown area.

The Boston Police Department said the recent robberies happened in Downtown Crossing, South Station, and on Tremont Street, where investigators say a stolen phone was allegedly used to commit financial fraud.
